checks: Full backup restores progress and exact transcripts, with audio only on explicit inclusion
Invalid content and future formats are rejected before changing progress
Failure to save the recovery journal leaves the current profile untouched
Interruption after the progress commit resumes without replacing newer progress
A committed conversation restore is idempotent even if journal cleanup failed and newer messages exist
Changes to conversations while restoration is pending are never silently overwritten
Deleting a conversation clears any pending import that contains its private text
Deleting a user removes their pending backup and pre-import recovery record
